digest.component_or_area: workflow orchestration - seam tests and step registry guards
propositions: Step registry membership cannot be statically verified because @register_step writes to a process-global dict via import side effects, and existing tests remain green even when registration imports are deleted due to pre-population from other test imports
Headroom guards are missing from plan_review/workflow_ops.py (794 LOC) and llm/config.py (793 LOC), which are the files that most need protection against regrowth
The stale rationale in test_gate_dispatch_seam.py names gate_dispatch.py as holding finalize_verdict call sites when those sites were moved to plan_review_recovery.py and plan_review/workflow_ops.py
Gate YAML resolution cannot be caught by schema validation, linting, or existing test_contracts.py because they either treat step names as free-form strings or only iterate already-registered steps
A subprocess-isolated registry check is required to observe first-import state and detect missing registration imports, since in-process checks are masked by test load ordering
